AccessResponse.description: The permissions the caller holds at some scope (display only: every call is still checked).

AdminInvitationResponse.description: `Invited` is false when the tenant already had an administrator, or on `Error`.

AssetChangeInput.description: New details of an asset (the code never changes; the site and status have their own operations).

AssetInput.description:
A new asset on a site; it starts `active`. `Meters` null gives it its type's default meters from 0, installed
on the acquisition date (else today); an empty list gives it none.

AssetListResponse.description: A page of the register, ordered by code; `NextCursor` is null on the last page.

AssetPhotoResponse.description: The asset's photo, served at `GET /{assetId}/photo`; `Sha256` changes with it (use it to refresh a cached image).

AssetResponse.description:
An asset; `Sites` lists its arrivals at sites, oldest first (each stay lasts until the next). `Label` is
what its QR label encodes (`KRY1:` and a random token), for the field app to match a scan offline.

AssetTypeResponse.description: A machine type: its default meters (`hours`, `km`) and component templates; the apps translate the codes.

AuditActorResponse.description: Someone who appears in the audit log the caller may read; `Name` null for a system actor.

AuditChange.description: One changed value between an event's `before` and `after`: a JSON path and both values.

AuditEntryResponse.description:
A ledger entry as the audit viewer shows it. `Event` is the entry turned back into its typed event and written
through the API's JSON contract, so sensitive fields are masked as in every response (ADR-0029 §2); null when this
version does not know the event type. `Changes`: the before/after diff of events that have both.
`ActorName`: the person's name when the actor is one of the company's people (else null: a system name such as
`seed-demo`, or someone no longer known).

BatchReceipt.description:
The answer to a batch, in its order; long BatchReceipt.LastSequence is the device's last stored sequence number and
DateTimeOffset BatchReceipt.ServerTime the server's clock when it answered (the tablet measures its offset from it, ADR-0031 §6).

ChangeFieldLevels.description: Replaces a role's field levels (a field left out gets the catalogue default of a default role, its fallback otherwise).

ChangeRole.description: Replaces a custom role's name, description, permissions and field levels (a field left out gets its fallback).

ChangeSet.description:
The answer of `GET /sync/changes` (ADR-0028 §5, `@karry/offline``ChangeSet`): a snapshot without a
cursor, else the changes since it; string ChangeSet.Cursor is what the tablet sends next time.

ChangeSubscription.description: New terms for a subscription: plan by code (its newest version unless `PlanVersion` is given) and the rest in full.

CollectionChanges.description: One collection of a change set: rows to keep, IDs to drop; bool CollectionChanges.Replace: the rows are the whole collection.

CommandReceipt.description:
What happened to one command: `accepted`, `conflict` (stored and flagged, IReadOnlyList<string> CommandReceipt.Flags),
`duplicate`, `waiting` (kept until an earlier number comes) or `rejected` (with string? CommandReceipt.Code;
bool CommandReceipt.Retryable when sending it again later can succeed). Every status but `rejected` means the server
has the command: the tablet marks it sent.

ConversionInput.description:
Converts `Quantity` to `Unit` (and `State` for m³) with the densities valid on `On` (default: the
company's today); `Moisture` replaces the material's default (a measured sample).

ConversionResponse.description: The converted quantity (full precision: round only for display), the factors used and the version's date.

CreateRole.description: A new custom role, from scratch or cloned from string? CreateRole.BasedOn (whose content fills what is left out).

DensityInput.description: Densities as the API receives them (t/m³; moisture as a mass fraction).

DensityVersionResponse.description: Densities in t/m³ from `EffectiveFrom`; `Swell` = bank / loose − 1 when both are known.

DeviceEnrolledResponse.description: What a tablet keeps after enrolling: who it is, for which company and site, and its PIN key (base64, once).

DevicePublicKey.description: The public half of the tablet's P-256 key, as a JWK (`kty` EC, `crv` P-256, base64url points).

DeviceSelf.description: The calling tablet as the API sees it (status, site, settings, server time for its clock).

DeviceSettings.description: How tablets behave (US-P1-OFF-04 AC2/AC3), sent to each tablet with its settings.

EnrollmentCreated.description: The code (only ever shown here) and the address a tablet opens to enrol with it.

EntitlementsResponse.description:
What the company may use now: plan, state, feature codes and limits (tenant-wide totals; a limit not listed is
unlimited). The apps show or lock features with it; the API checks every call.

FlagResponse.description:
A declared flag: its default, this environment's configured value and the platform-wide value (null when not set).
Company and user overrides come before these.

ImportIssueResponse.description: A problem: `row` 0 is the file itself, 1 the headers; `severity` is `error` (blocks the commit) or `warning`.

ImportResponse.description:
An import: `status` is `validating`, `validated`, `committing`, `committed` or
`discarded`; the counts are those of the last validation, and of the commit once committed.

ImportRowResponse.description: A row of the preview: `action` is `create`, `update` or `unchanged`.

InvoiceResponse.description: An invoice Karry issued (decimal amount in its currency's minor units; negative for a credit note).

LabelSheetInput.description: Labels to print in this order on A4 sheets; `Skip` leaves the first labels of a partly used sheet empty.

LatestVerificationResponse.description:
The last integrity check of the company's ledger and who ran it (their name when they are one of the company's
people); all null before the first one.

MaterialInput.description: A new material with its first densities; `EffectiveFrom` defaults to the company's today (any date is allowed).

MaterialResponse.description: A material; `Densities` lists its versions, oldest first (each valid until the next one).

MeterInput.description: A new meter: `Kind` hours or km, the value shown when installed (default 0) and the date (default the company's today).

MeterResponse.description:
A meter: `Kind` hours or km, counted in `Unit` (h, km); `LastValue` and `LastReadAt` are its
latest reading (the initial one at first); `Offset` stays 0 until meter replacement (Phase 2).

MeterStatusRequest.description: `Status`: ok or failed (replacement comes with field operations).

MrrTotalResponse.description: The MRR of all tenants priced in one currency.

OperatorTenantListResponse.description: Every tenant, by name, and the MRR totals by currency.

OperatorTenantResponse.description:
A tenant in the operator console (US-P1-OPS-03 AC1). `Status` is the subscription state (trial, active,
past_due, …); `Mrr` the monthly recurring revenue in `MrrCurrency` (zero when nothing is billed, null when
the plan has no price); counts are null when unknown. `Complete` false: a module failed for this tenant and its
columns are empty.

PermissionCatalogResponse.description: What roles can contain: every permission and sensitive field the modules declare.

PlanPriceDto.description: A price book line as the API writes it: `period` is `monthly` or `annual`.

PlanResponse.description: One plan version. `Limits`: a limit not listed is unlimited. `Prices`: empty for plans quoted by sales.

ProvisionTenant.description: A tenant to provision; `Admin` (optional) is invited by e-mail as first Tenant Admin (US-P1-TEN-01 AC1).

ProvisionedTenantResponse.description: The provisioned tenant; `AdminInvitation` is the outcome of the first administrator invitation when one was requested.

PublishPlan.description: A new version of a plan (or its first): the full content, nothing carried over implicitly.

QuantityInput.description: A quantity as the API receives it: `{value, unit, state}`.

QuantityResponse.description: A quantity on the wire: `State` is bank, loose or compacted for m³ and null otherwise.

ReadingInput.description: What a meter shows; `ReadAt` defaults to now.

ReadingListResponse.description: A page of readings, newest first; `NextCursor` is null on the last page.

ReadingResponse.description: A reading: the value shown at `ReadAt`, received at `RecordedAt` from `RecordedBy` (a user subject).

RoleAssignment.description: A role held tenant-wide (Guid? RoleAssignment.SiteId null) or on one site (US-P1-IAM-03 AC1, US-P1-IAM-06).

RoleResponse.description: A role: default (name translated by the apps from the code) or custom; field levels of every declared field.

ShiftInstanceResponse.description: A shift on a date (the local date it starts on), as UTC instants; its real length follows clock changes.

ShiftPatternResponse.description: A pattern version: its shifts from `EffectiveFrom` (a local date of the site) until the next version.

ShiftResponse.description: A shift: "HH:mm" on the site's clock (an end not after the start is the next day), days "mon".."sun".

SiteInput.description: Site input as the API receives it; `Boundary` is a GeoJSON polygon's coordinates ([longitude, latitude]).

SiteResponse.description: A site; `Boundary` is a GeoJSON polygon ([longitude, latitude]) or null.

StartSupportSession.description: Opens a support session: the company's code, or (break-glass) a written reason.

SubscriptionAction.description: An operator action on the state: `activate`, `missed-payment`, `payment` or `cancel`.

SubscriptionResponse.description:
A tenant's subscription. `Status`: trial, active, past_due, restricted, suspended, cancelled, expired,
deleted. `Period`: monthly or annual. Limits and features are resolved with the entitlements (slice 3).

SupportConsentResponse.description: The code (shown once) a Tenant Admin reads to Karry support, and until when it can be used.

SupportSessionResponse.description: A support session as the company and Karry see it (the operator's account ID is not shown to the company).

TenantBrandingResponse.description: Public sign-in branding: no data beyond what the sign-in page shows.

TenantFlagResponse.description: A company override (`UserSubject` null) or a user's; `Enabled` null: removed.

TenantResponse.description: The caller's company with its settings (US-P1-TEN-04); `LogoUrl` is null without a logo.

UpdateTenantSettings.description: New settings, every field given (a full replacement).

UploadedCommand.description:
A command as the tablet's outbox holds it (ADR-0028 §6, `@karry/offline``OutboxRecord`):
Signature is ES256 (IEEE P1363, base64url) over the RFC 8785 form of the other five members.

UsageLineResponse.description: One metric: the live count, the tenant-wide limit and ceiling (null: unlimited), and its state.

UsageResponse.description:
The company's usage now. `State`: within, over (above the limit: banner, nothing blocked) or blocked (at the
ceiling, the limit plus its 10 % grace: no more creation; field capture never). `SnapshotOn`: the last daily
snapshot.

UserResponse.description: A user; `pinSet` tells whether a field user has a PIN (an imported one has none until an administrator sets it).
